title: We're Not Afraid to Die... if We Can All Be Together

topics.title: The dream voyage and its early stages

concepts.learning_objective: Recall who undertook the voyage, why, and in what boat.
Trace the route of the first leg and explain why extra crew were taken on.

topics.title: The great wave strikes on January 2

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the precautions taken to protect the ship as the weather worsened.
Interpret the narrator's description of the giant wave and his experience of it.

topics.title: Fighting the flood and the children's courage

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the steps taken to check the flooding of the ship.
Evaluate how the children's behaviour reveals courage and selflessness.
Explain how the narrator navigated without proper instruments to find the island.
Analyse how optimism and family bonds helped the voyagers endure the direst stress.

topics.title: Words and expressions from the account

concepts.learning_objective: Identify ship terms that have other common meanings and use them in context.
Infer the meaning of phrasal verbs and expressions from their context in the account.
